cultural.vision_reason: Studio carte-de-visite portrait of three Paiute (Pahute) men in traditional dress—fringed/embroidered shirts, leggings, hair ornaments, moccasins—documenting their attire, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); carte-de-visite
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) carte de visite; studio portrait of three Paiute men sitting on chairs; the Paiute man on the far left is wearing hair ornaments, an embroidered shirt with tassels, a sash worn across his chest, a pair of embroidered leggings with flaps, a pair of moccasins, and he is holding a tomahawk(?) in his left hand above the second man's head; the Paiute man sitting in the centre, is wearing a hair ornament in his hair, a cloth shirt, a blanket wrapped around his waist, a pair of leggings with hide flaps, and a pair of moccasins; the Paiute man on the far right is sitting with his left leg over his right knee, and is wearing a feather in his hair, a necklace, a shirt, a pair of leggings with flaps, and a pair of moccasins; Salt Lake City, United States of America 
Albumen print
